CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsSimpleValue

Returns YES for simple values: strings, numbers, Booleans and date/time values. Returns NO for complex values: arrays, structures, queries, binary data and objects.

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsSimpleValue(value)

Parameters

value
Any value.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Only simple values can be output with #...#, used in string functions or stored in Client variables and cookies. When you write generic code (a custom tag, a debugging include), test with IsSimpleValue first and use IsArray, IsStruct or IsQuery to handle the rest.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Things = StructNew()>
<CFSET Things.AString = "Hello">
<CFSET Things.ANumber = 56000>
<CFSET Things.ADate = Now()>
<CFSET Things.AnArray = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Things.AStruct = StructNew()>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Key</TH><TH>IsSimpleValue</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP COLLECTION="#Things#" ITEM="k">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#k#</TD><TD>#IsSimpleValue(Things[k])#</TD>
<TD><CFIF IsSimpleValue(Things[k])>#Things[k]#<CFELSE><I>(complex value)</I></CFIF></TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

IsArray, IsStruct, IsQuery, IsBinary
